description: This Java class provides enumeration utilities for attendance types within the Fineract project, including methods to convert attendance types to EnumOptionData objects and to generate lists of such options.

classes.name: AttendanceEnumerations
classes.description: Utility class for handling attendance type enumerations and conversions.

methods.name: attendanceType(int)
methods.description: Converts an integer attendance type to an EnumOptionData object.

methods.name: attendanceType(AttendanceType)
methods.description: Converts an AttendanceType enum to an EnumOptionData object.

methods.name: attendanceType(AttendanceType[])
methods.description: Generates a list of EnumOptionData objects for an array of AttendanceType enums, excluding invalid types.
